html:
G'oya

Sirpanuvchi oyna: har bir kun uchun oxirgi yetti kunlik yig'indi. Oyna funksiyasining freymi buni bitta o'tishda hisoblaydi. Muhimi freym turi: ROWS qatorlarni sanaydi, RANGE esa ORDER BY ustunining qiymatlariga qaraydi. Yopiq kunlar jadvalda yo'q, shuning uchun "oxirgi yettita qator" va "oxirgi yetti kun" har xil narsa.

Yechim

SELECT store_id, day, amount,
       SUM(amount) OVER (PARTITION BY store_id ORDER BY day
                         RANGE BETWEEN 6 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS week_total
FROM sales

RANGE BETWEEN 6 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW day qiymati day - 6 dan day gacha bo'lgan qatorlarni oladi. PostgreSQL ham, SQLite ham son ustunida bunday freymni qo'llaydi.

Tuzoqlar

Ichki so'rov to'g'ri natija beradi, lekin har bir yozuv uchun shu do'konning hamma yozuvlarini ko'rib chiqadi: store_id indeksi faqat do'konni ajratadi, do'konda esa to'rt ming yozuv bor.

SELECT s.store_id, s.day, s.amount,
       (SELECT SUM(p.amount)
        FROM sales p
        WHERE p.store_id = s.store_id
          AND p.day BETWEEN s.day - 6 AND s.day) AS week_total
FROM sales s

ROWS freymi oradagi yopiq kunlarni bilmaydi va oynani orqaga cho'zib yuboradi. Namunada 9-kun uchun u 1-, 2-, 3-, 5-, 8- va 9-kunlarning hammasini oladi, 1- va 2-kun esa yetti kunlik oynadan tashqarida.

Noto'g'riSELECT store_id, day, amount,
       SUM(amount) OVER (PARTITION BY store_id ORDER BY day
                         ROWS BETWEEN 6 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS week_total
FROM sales
